gold: Stage IIIC (T4aN3) melanoma with satellite metastases

selector.why: The evidence of an incidentally resected lymph node with focal involvement and the histopathology findings, including the presence of melanocytes highlighted by SOX-10 and MART-1, decided it.

support_spans: An incidentally resected lymph node was found to be focally involved, with no evidence of distant metastatic disease
H&E sections showed intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate composed of numerous neutrophils, histiocytes, eosinophils, and lymphocytes
SOX-10 and MART-1: Highlighted normal melanocytes in basal layer of epidermis only
